$Comment: Put by a war cry (the Rallying affix) on the crying mob and on every creature near it that is hostile to its target, for the affix's Cry.BuffSeconds: that length wins over the Duration here. It is the game's pack enrage, Dungeon_Goblin_Enraged: a quarter more damage of every kind and a quarter more speed, with the red unblockable flare. The damage adds to whatever damage bonus a scaled mob already carries, as every damage effect does. No body tint: the rarity aura owns that. Change what a rally does here.
